verdicts.reason: The two are almost pixel-identical. The only visible difference is a small shift in the decorative dots at the bottom. Both share the same flaws: the original's main industrial-plant photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail next to 'WORLD'S', so a key image is made trivial. The black rule cuts into the left edge of the cooling-tower photo, which is an unwanted collision. That photo sits slightly off-centre, with unequal left and right margins. 'Biggest' nearly touches the right edge of the canvas, and the dot clusters look scattered at random rather than placed with intent.
